title: Üç Kaşığa Bir Elmas
visualStyle: Rich 17th-century Ottoman oil painting in the manner of an old master, dramatic candlelight chiaroscuro, deep warm shadows, visible canvas texture and fine varnish cracks, museum archive reproduction.

cast.balikci: a poor Ottoman fisherman in the 1600s, about forty, lean sun-darkened face, short grey-streaked beard, faded red cloth cap, patched loose linen shirt
cast.kasikci: an Ottoman spoon maker in the 1600s, about fifty, plump face, sly narrow eyes, neat black beard, small white turban, leather work apron

imagePrompts: Extreme close-up of weathered bare hands digging through a pile of rubbish and seaweed on a muddy shore at dawn

imagePrompts.prompt: Extreme close-up of the man's eyes narrowing at something glinting below him, half of his face in deep shadow

imagePrompts: Close-up of three plain carved wooden spoons lying side by side on a rough wooden workbench, candlelight
Extreme close-up of a brass jeweler's loupe held against an eye, candle flame reflected in the lens

scenes.say: [whispers] Bir çöplük... Üç tahta kaşık... [dramatic] Ve bir elmas.

scenes.title: Üç Kaşığa Bir Elmas
scenes.imagePrompt: The man stands alone on a rocky shore facing the viewer, the domes and minarets of old Istanbul rising in the hazy distance behind him, morning light
scenes.sound: waves on a rocky shore, seagulls, distant city bells
scenes.say: [curious] Bu... üç kaşığa satılan bir elmasın hikâyesi.

scenes.label: Kırat
scenes.say: [confident] Tam seksen altı kırat.

scenes.label: Pırlanta
scenes.say: [confident] Etrafında kırk dokuz pırlanta.

scenes.text: Ama hikâye bir sarayda değil bir çöplükte başlıyor
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide view of a rubbish heap on a muddy shore beside old stone city walls at dawn, a lone fisherman bending over it on the far left, empty sky and sea to the right
scenes.say: [curious] Ama hikâye bir sarayda değil... bir çöplükte başlıyor.

scenes.imagePrompt: The man kneeling on the shore on the left of the frame, holding a dirty glittering stone in his open palm and staring at it, puzzled, soft dawn light
scenes.name: Bir balıkçı
scenes.sound: quiet shore at dawn, water lapping on stones
scenes.say: [warmly] Rivayete göre Eğrikapı'da fakir bir balıkçı... çöplükte parlak bir taş buldu.

scenes.imagePrompt: The man in his cramped workshop on the right of the frame, lifting a small stone toward a candle and studying it with narrow, calculating eyes, wooden spoons hanging on the wall behind
scenes.name: Kaşıkçı
scenes.sound: small workshop, wood carving scrapes, distant bazaar murmur
scenes.say: [quietly] Taşı, çarşıdaki bir kaşıkçıya götürdü.

scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up of three plain wooden spoons being placed into a poor man's open calloused palm by a well-fed hand, candlelight
scenes.sound: quiet workshop, a single coin dropping, fabric rustle
scenes.say: Kaşıkçı taşa karşılık... [dramatic] üç kaşık verdi.

scenes.imagePrompt: The silhouette of the fisherman walking away alone along the shore at sunset, three wooden spoons in his hand, long shadow on the wet sand
scenes.caption: Bir servet, üç kaşık
scenes.sound: evening waves, lonely gulls far away
scenes.say: [sighs] Balıkçı, hayatının servetini... üç kaşığa bırakmıştı.

scenes.text: Peki bir balıkçı bir elması nasıl tanımaz
scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up of ordinary grey pebbles on a wet shore at dawn, one cloudy dull stone among them catching a faint glint
scenes.say: [curious] Peki bir balıkçı... bir elması nasıl tanımaz?

scenes.imagePrompt: Macro close-up of a rough uncut diamond crystal, cloudy and dull like an ordinary pebble, lying in a weathered open palm
scenes.caption: Ham elmas: bulanık bir çakıl
scenes.say: [warmly] Çünkü ham elmas... bulanık, sıradan bir çakıl taşına benzer.

scenes.imagePrompt: An old craftsman pressing a large gem against a spinning stone polishing wheel in a candlelit workshop, fine sparks of light flying from it
scenes.sound: grinding stone wheel, soft rhythmic creak, candle crackle
scenes.say: [quietly] Işığı ancak kesilip parlatılınca... ortaya çıkar.

scenes.text: Taş el değiştirdi her seferinde değeri katlandı
scenes.imagePrompt: Dramatic close-up of richly dressed hands passing a large rough stone from one to another over a table of gold coins, candlelight, deep shadow
scenes.sound: coins clinking, low murmuring voices in a stone room
scenes.say: [serious] Taş el değiştirdi... her seferinde değeri katlandı.

scenes.imagePrompt: An old court jeweler in rich dark robes on the left of the frame, raising a brass loupe to his eye to examine a stone, frozen in astonishment, a single candle
scenes.name: Saray kuyumcusu
scenes.sound: silent chamber, candle flame flickering, a clock ticking
scenes.say: [quietly] Sonunda bir kuyumcu taşa baktı... ve donup kaldı.

scenes.imagePrompt: A huge pear-shaped diamond held in tweezers in front of a candle flame, light exploding out of it into sharp sparkling rays, darkness around
scenes.say: Bu bir cam parçası değildi... [dramatic] bir elmastı.

scenes.imagePrompt: A vast torchlit Ottoman palace treasury chamber, the diamond set in gold and ringed with small diamonds displayed on a velvet cushion, gold vessels glowing all around
scenes.caption: Osmanlı hazinesi
scenes.sound: echoing stone hall, faint footsteps, torches crackling
scenes.say: [confident] Taş sonunda saraya... Osmanlı hazinesine girdi.

scenes.imagePrompt: The pear-shaped diamond ringed with small diamonds glittering inside an old glass display case in a dim vaulted stone room, soft light from above
scenes.sound: quiet museum hall, soft distant echo
scenes.say: [warmly] Ve bugün hâlâ... Topkapı Sarayı'nda duruyor.

scenes.imagePrompt: The fisherman grown old, sitting alone on a rock by the sea at dusk on the right of the frame, turning a worn wooden spoon in his fingers, looking at the water
scenes.caption: Adı bile bilinmiyor
scenes.say: [softly] Onu bulan balıkçının ise... adı bile bilinmiyor.

scenes.text: Bir taş üç kaşık ve dört yüz yıllık bir efsane
scenes.imagePrompt: The pear-shaped diamond glowing faintly in total darkness like a distant star, a thin beam of light falling on it
scenes.say: [slowly] Bir taş... üç kaşık... ve dört yüz yıllık bir efsane.

scenes.text: Bazen en büyük servet onu tanımayanın elinde durur
scenes.imagePrompt: A single worn wooden spoon lying on wet sand at dusk, gentle waves behind it, empty shore stretching away
scenes.sound: gentle waves on sand at dusk
scenes.say: [softly] Bazen en büyük servet... onu tanımayanın elinde durur.
